title: Stage Profiling Breakdown Chart
description: A stacked bar and pie view of capture, compute, and draw time as shares of one pipeline cycle, with a click-through verdict on each stage's optimization payoff.
creator: Real-Time DSP on a $5 Microcontroller
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Digital Signal Processing
Performance Analysis
Profiling

learningObjectives: Judge which pipeline stage to optimize from measured shares
Apply Amdahl's bound to each stage
Explain why intuition is a poor guide to bottlenecks

controls.label: Any segment
controls.purpose: Show that stage's share and optimization verdict

equations: max overall saving from a stage = that stage's share
limitations: Real profiles vary with FFT size, display size, and SPI clock; these proportions are illustrative of the common case

keyQuestions: What is the maximum saving available from each stage?
Why is optimizing capture a waste of effort?
commonMisconceptions: That the most interesting code is the most expensive code
That any speedup in any stage is worth having
assessmentOpportunities: Compute the overall effect of a 40% capture-stage speedup
